cities.name: Baku
interests: Urban Culture & Caspian Sea Coast 🏙️ — Long seaside promenades, modern plazas and atmospheric waterfront views.
History & Old City Walls 🏛️ — UNESCO-listed Icherisheher full of stone alleys, mosques and timeless architecture.
Modern Architecture & Nightlife 🌃 — Flame Towers, futuristic museums and vibrant nightlife in a glowing city.
cities.local_food_tip: Try rich Azerbaijani dishes such as plov, piti soup, dolma, lamb kebabs, qutab and sweet pakhlava. A perfect mix of Caspian seafood, aromatic spices and warm Middle Eastern flavors.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🌅 Start early at the iconic Baku Boulevard: A long seaside promenade with smooth Caspian breezes. → 🏛️ Enter the UNESCO-listed Old City (Icherisheher): Explore Maiden Tower, medieval walls, traditional houses and historic mosques. → ☕ Tea break at Çay Bağı — classic Azeri tea with baklava. Afternoon: 🌇 Take the funicular up to Upland Park: Stunning views over the harbor and skyline. → 🔥 Walk around the futuristic Flame Towers and modern stairways. → 🍽️ Lunch at Şirvanshah Museum Restaurant: Traditional dishes served in a historic stone setting. Late Afternoon: 🚶 Stroll through elegant Fountains Square and explore Nizami Street — bookstores, cafés and urban culture. → 🎨 Visit the iconic Azerbaijan Carpet Museum for incredible textile art. Sunset: 🌅 Enjoy golden light from Baku Boulevard or a rooftop overlooking the Caspian. Night: 🌃 Dinner with live Mugham at Mugam Club. → Illuminated Old City or seaside promenade walk — perfect end to the day.

ideas: 🌸 Blossoming parks along Baku Boulevard.
🎨 Outdoor art fairs and small pop-up exhibitions in the Old City.
☕ Terrace cafés on Nizami Street — perfect mild weather for long breaks.
🌊 Cool breezy night walks along the Caspian Sea promenade.
🍹 Rooftop dining with Flame Tower views.
🎶 Lively nightlife — bars, lounges and summer festivals across the city.
🍁 Golden sunset light hitting Old City walls — ideal for photos.
🥘 Warm stews, piti soup and kebabs in traditional restaurants.
🏛️ Museum visits and cultural exhibitions in cooler weather.
🌫️ Atmospheric seaside mornings with Caspian mist.
🔥 Hot tea and desserts in cozy Old City teahouses.
📸 Night skyline photography featuring the glowing Flame Towers.

public_transport_tips: 🚇 Use the Baku Metro — fast and efficient: metro.gov.az.
🚶 Old City, Boulevard and Nizami Street are all perfect for walking.
🚕 Taxis and Bolt are affordable for medium distances.
🎟️ Get a day pass if you plan several metro and bus rides.

city_events.description: 🏛️ Historic tours, artisan workshops and cultural storytelling.

cities.name: Sheki
interests: Historic Silk Road Heritage 🕌 — Caravanserais, palaces and timeless trade routes.
Nature & Mountain Villages 🌄 — Lush greenery, forested slopes and remote scenery.
Local Crafts & Traditional Life 🎨 — Silk, embroidery, woodwork and artisan sweets.
cities.local_food_tip: Try Sheki pakhlava, piti soup, handmade walnut pastries, qutab and rustic mountain stews — cozy flavors shaped by mountain life.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏰 Begin at the magnificent Sheki Khan’s Palace: Stained-glass windows, frescoes and serene courtyards. → Walk into the historic Caravanserai Complex: Silk Road architecture and atmospheric stone chambers. → ☕ Tea and pastries at a nearby teahouse. Afternoon: 🌳 Visit nearby forested hills or local villages for quiet nature escapes. → 🍽️ Lunch at Çelebi Xan Restaurant — authentic local meals. → Explore craft shops selling silk, hand-carved wood and traditional patterns. Sunset: 🌇 Enjoy warm golden light falling on surrounding mountain slopes. Night: 🌙 Relax in the Caravanserai courtyard café or enjoy a peaceful stroll through narrow historic lanes.

ideas: 🌼 Blossom-filled palace gardens and fresh greenery.
🎨 Artisan craft markets featuring silk and handmade goods.
🍃 Mild temperatures perfect for old-town walking tours.
🌄 Scenic hikes in Sheki’s forested mountains.
🌙 Evening tea in shaded palace courtyards.
🥗 Refreshing meals with yogurt, herbs and vegetables.
🍁 Bright autumn colors along mountain valleys.
🥘 Walnut-rich dishes and hearty stews.
🏘️ Quiet historical walks with fewer visitors.
❄️ Frosty mornings around the palace and hills.
🔥 Tea in warm carpeted homes and teahouses.
🕯️ Peaceful evenings in the old quarter.

public_transport_tips: 🚍 Minibuses operate between Baku and Sheki several times daily.
🚶 Old town is compact and best explored on foot.
🚗 A rental car is helpful for reaching mountain villages.
🥾 Wear good shoes — cobblestone and uneven paths are common.

city_events.name: Sheki Crafts & Sweets Festival
city_events.description: 🍬 Artisan sweets, local craft stalls, folk music and cultural workshops.

cities.name: Gabala
interests: Mountains, Valleys & Forests 🌲 — Fresh air, waterfalls and colorful landscapes.
Nature & Hiking 🥾 — Trails for all fitness levels across mountain terrain.
Winter Sports & Outdoor Activities 🎿 — Skiing, snowboarding and winter fun.
cities.local_food_tip: Taste mountain soups, grilled lamb, forest mushrooms, qutab and local dairy — hearty and perfect for outdoor adventures.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏞️ Start your nature day at Yeddi Gozel Waterfall (Seven Beauties): Short trails, forest air and viewing platforms. → Enjoy a scenic forest break. → 🍽️ Early lunch at a local mountain tavern. Afternoon: 🎿 In winter: Skiing or snowboarding at Tufandag Ski Resort. → In warmer seasons: Relax at Nohur Lake: Rowboats, photography and peaceful nature. Sunset: 🌅 Watch sunset reflections at the lakeside. Night: 🔥 Dinner at a mountain lodge — grilled meats, tea and calm rural atmosphere.

ideas: 🌼 Blooming forests and flowing waterfalls.
🥾 Ideal moderate-weather hiking.
📸 Crisp valley and mountain views.
🌲 Cool forest trails during hot months.
🏕️ Lakeside picnics and canoeing.
🌌 Clear, starry skies for night photography.
🍁 Bright golden forests and mountain panoramas.
🥘 Warm mountain stews and local comfort food.
🔥 Cozy lodge evenings after outdoor walks.
🎿 Skiing and snowboarding at Tufandag.
☕ Hot drinks and warm desserts afterward.
❄️ Snow-covered paths and peaceful silence.

public_transport_tips: 🚍 Intercity buses connect Gabala with major cities.
🚗 Car rental recommended for mountain areas.
🥾 Wear sturdy shoes — terrain can be uneven.
🎟️ Check seasonal ski passes for Tufandag.

city_events.name: Gabala Nature Week
city_events.description: 🥾 Guided forest hikes, nature tours and village experiences.

city_events.description: ⛷️ Opening ceremony with music, food and winter sports events.

cities.name: Khinalig (Shegar)
interests: High-Altitude Mountain Village 🏔️ — One of the oldest settlements in the Caucasus.
Traditional Culture & Village Life 🏡 — Ancient traditions, handmade crafts and rural lifestyle.
Remote Nature & Scenic Trails 🌄 — Wild landscapes, strong winds and dramatic skies.
cities.local_food_tip: Expect homemade dishes: fresh bread, dairy, potatoes, lamb stew and endless tea — simple, warm and perfect for cold mountain climates.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🌄 Journey to the ancient mountain village Khinalig: One of the highest and oldest settlements in the Caucasus. → Explore stone houses, steep paths and panoramic ridges. Afternoon: 🐑 Meet local families, learn about wool crafts and traditional mountain life. → 🍲 Enjoy a home-style lunch prepared by villagers. Sunset: 🌇 Watch the sun drop behind tall dramatic peaks. Night: 🕯️ Spend the evening in a mountain guesthouse with warm tea, firelight and starry skies.

ideas: 🌼 Fresh meadows and melting snow streams.
🦅 Birdwatching in high-altitude landscapes.
🚶 Mild scenic walks around the village.
🏕️ Homestays in traditional stone houses.
🌞 Long daylight hikes at cooler altitudes.
🛖 Cultural exchanges with villagers.
🍂 Red, gold and copper slopes — breathtaking views.
🔥 Warm dinners and herbal teas in family homes.
📸 Exceptional photography conditions.
❄️ Deep snow and total tranquility.
🔥 Cozy evenings with tea and fire.
🌌 Crystal-clear night skies over the mountains.

public_transport_tips: 🚗 4x4 vehicle strongly recommended — roads are rough.
🎒 Bring warm layers even in summer.
🥾 Mountain boots required for all terrain.
📅 Best travel time: late spring to early autumn.

city_events.name: Highland Village Traditions Day
city_events.description: 🎶 Folk music, crafts and cultural gatherings in Khinalig.
